name: Approval flow
purpose: Walk a request through submit, review, and a recorded approve or reject decision.
scenarios: Review an open request against a three-step tracker
Approve or reject with a required comment
Show a success or error result after the decision

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

status.description: Initial request status: pending, approved, or rejected.

onDecide.description: Called with the decision and comment after client validation.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

antiPatterns: Do not skip the comment field when recording a decision.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Tab reaches decision radios, comment, and submit
a11y.focus: Fields and actions remain in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Steps, decision radios, comment, and submit have accessible names.

responsive.strategy: Single-column card; steps adapt with their own @container queries. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.compact: Steps stack; form uses full inline size with 44px targets.
breakpoints.medium: Steps sit in a row when the stepper container allows.
breakpoints.large: Steps sit in a row when the stepper container allows.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language, never a hardcoded ltr attribute.
